caption: Grey raw shrimp are dropped into a hot pan, and they curl and turn pink.

sa.check: Grey raw shrimp are dropped into a hot pan.
Each shrimp tightens into a curve.
The shrimp turn from grey to pink.
The change starts on the side touching the pan.
The shrimp look translucent at the start.
The drop comes first and the curling follows.

pc.expect: The curling and the colour change only advance and do not reverse.
pc.fail: A curled shrimp straightens out again in the hot pan; or a pink shrimp turns grey again; or the shrimp curl and uncurl in turn; or the colour change spreads and then retreats.

pc.expect: The change is in the shrimp themselves, starting on the side touching the pan and spreading through each one.
pc.fail: The pan's surface changes colour rather than the shrimp; or a shrimp turns pink on its upper side while the side on the metal stays grey; or the shrimp are pink before they reach the pan; or the shrimp all change colour in a single frame with no spreading.

pc.expect: Each shrimp stays one shrimp that draws into a tighter curve, keeping its tail and body.
pc.fail: A shrimp splits into pieces with nothing cutting it; or the shrimp fuse into one mass; or a shrimp curls into a closed ring with no seam; or a shrimp turns into another object.

pc.expect: The shrimp rest in the pan and any juices run to its low places.
pc.fail: A shrimp lifts off the pan and hangs; or the juices climb the pan's wall and stay; or a shrimp rolls uphill in a tilted pan; or the juices gather on top of a shrimp and stay.

pc.expect: The shrimp keep their number in the pan and none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A shrimp vanishes; or a new shrimp appears in the pan; or two shrimp merge into one; or a shrimp passes through the pan's floor.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The shrimp's colour change is the caption's asserted outcome; the chemistry of it is not judged, only that it runs one way and starts where the shrimp meet the pan.
